links.outcome: Junior investigators working with CoTI versus CoTI alone; possible overreliance
links.effect: Human-AI collaboration between CoTI and junior investigators gave only marginal gains compared to CoTI alone; junior investigators may over-rely on CoTI (hypothesis).
links.quote: In an exploratory human-AI collaboration experiment, we found that the collaboration between CoTI and junior investigators provided only marginal gains compared to CoTI alone.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM prompt refinement (Instructor agent) to generate themes for qualitative analysis

screen.reason: The study develops a multi-agent LLM tool (CoTI) for qualitative analysis of healthcare transcripts and empirically tests human-AI interaction/collaboration comparing CoTI alone vs. junior investigator collaboration with the tool.
